Librerias de terceros, copiadas tal cual de npm para que la app funcione sin internet.
Se resuelven con el <script type="importmap"> de index.html.

  OrbitControls.js           three@0.169.0 (examples/jsm/controls)  MIT
  three-mesh-bvh.module.js   three-mesh-bvh@0.8.3   MIT  https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-mesh-bvh
  three-bvh-csg.module.js    three-bvh-csg@0.0.16   MIT  https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-bvh-csg
